notes: Peru: Lima (Miraflores, San Isidro-adjacent, Surco, La Molina, San Borja, Lince, Callao, north Lima), Trujillo, Cusco, Arequipa, Iquitos covered partially. No national duty rota or animal poison line found on official pages (CMVP and SENASA pages have none). Not done / not reachable: Pancho Cavero (panchocavero.com contact pages errored, clinicaveterinariapanchocavero.com robots-blocked), Veterinaria San Diego Miraflores (robots-blocked; 24 h only in a 2022 CCL article), CUVET (robots-blocked), Pharmavet, Veterinaria Consentidos, Veterinaria Orbegoso, Cusco Can (robots-blocked), UNALM consultorio, UPCH favez site (robots-blocked); Lazzy Vet Cusco (site content did not render); Vetsalud Arequipa (24 h only on aggregator feelingperu.com); Repets, CIMVET, Alpha Vet, AQP Vet Arequipa (no own site reachable); Gala Pets, El Hurón Azul, Cedivet, Animal World (no own site found); Piura and San Isidro/Callao 24-h clinics (no own site found); Pets and Love Lince (24 h label ambiguous). HeyVet San Miguel not yet open (waitlist).
